title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CP-012B in Participants With Parkinson’s Disease With Early Morning OFF Episodes
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Parallel Treatment Arms, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CP-012B in Participants with Parkinson’s Disease with Early Morning OFF Episodes
summary: Main objective: To evaluate CP-012B versus placebo in mornings waking up in an ON state assessed with the eDiary after 6 weeks of treatment in participants with PD on stable daytime CD/LD treatment.
conditions: Parkinson’s Disease With Early Morning OFF Episodes
